- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for sustained positive sentiment.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >75% from prior day) — add 3–5% buffer to forecast for rebound.
- Overshoot downward trends with negative sentiment — cap forecast below 10% below recent low if sentiment < -0.30.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 2–4% per day until convergence.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops sharply 2–3 days before forecast, adjust forecast down 3–7% to account for delayed reaction.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen forecast by 10–15% if sentiment is volatile or recent.
